text:
maria_ae: Hey team — quick sync on LumenHealth trial scoping. They want a 3-week POC for clinical summarization. Key asks: streaming API for live notes, ~2M tokens/month estimate, SOC2 screening. Can SE + Security advise on auth, quotas, and success criteria? cc @sam_se @rachel_cs

sam_se: Thanks — clarifying Qs: 1) streaming: do they need partial (token-level) deltas or chunked sentence-level updates? 2) expected concurrency (RPS)? 3) will they also need embeddings for retrieval to improve summaries?

rachel_cs: From CS: timeline is 3 weeks, milestone checkpoints weekly. Success baseline: ingest sample EHR subset, run 1k prompts against gold set, evaluate ROUGE/F1 and hallucination rate.

sam_se: For streaming we'd recommend SSE/Websocket via our SDK. If token-level partials required, enable stream=true and use client.on('token', cb). Quick cURL example to show streaming: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\n  -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-clinical-1","stream":true,"prompt":"Summarize clinical note..."}'
```

tom_infra: Quotas: default trial gets 5 RPS and ~200k tokens/day. For an enterprise POC we can uplift to 20 RPS and 2M tokens/day (temporary) after a signed trial agreement. Need IP allowlist and sandbox VPC egress details from LumenHealth.

alex_prod: Retry guidance: use idempotency-key per request + exponential backoff with jitter. SDK default: retries=3, base=200ms. For streaming the client exposes a resume token header so you can resume from last committed token if transient error occurs.

security_engineer: A couple security points: 1) Is PHI in scope? If yes, BAA required and we recommend Dedicated/Private. 2) Hosted has AES-256 at rest + managed KMS; Dedicated supports customer-managed keys. I'll share an abridged questionnaire and the BAA checklist.

maria_ae: LumenHealth says they will pseudonymize but may process PHI in edge cases. They asked specifically about KMS + audit logs retention.

security_engineer: We provide audit logs for admin actions and access. KMS: customer-managed keys available on Dedicated. For hosted we can enable customer key wrapping for an enterprise contract. I'll DM the abridged security PDF.

rachel_cs: Draft success criteria for the POC (proposed):
- Ingest 10k clinical notes into sandbox
- Run 1k evaluation prompts against gold set
- Summarization F1 >= 0.8 and hallucination rate <= 2%
- Mean server-side latency <= 800ms at target concurrency (2 RPS sustained, burst 5 RPS)
- No P0 security issues uncovered in questionnaire
Delivery cadence: weekly checkpoint + final demo at week 3.

maria_ae: Next steps:
- @sam_se: share SDK snippets (streaming + idempotency examples) + auth options by EOD
- @tom_infra: confirm quota uplift process and timeline (how fast can we enable 20 RPS / 2M tokens/day)
- @security_engineer: send abridged questionnaire and BAA checklist; flag any blockers for pseudonymized PHI
- Book 30m sync with LumenHealth tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk through integration approach and sample data ingestion

lumen_ops: LumenHealth Ops here — 10am PT works. We'll provide sample notes (de-identified) and a sandbox S3 endpoint. One ask: when streaming, can you include source offsets so we can map summary tokens back to original note positions?

sam_se: Yes — we can include structured token metadata with offsets in the structured_output.tokens[].metadata.offsets field. I'll validate with a quick run on their sample set and share a tiny eval harness (node + python).

maria_ae: Great, added to calendar :thumbsup:

sam_se: I'll post the SDK snippets and the small eval harness link in this thread once ready. Also recommend they provision a short-lived API key scoped to sandbox for the POC rather than sharing a long-lived production key.

tom_infra: Confirmed on uplift timeline — infra can enable the quota bump within 24 hours of signed trial terms. Will share the internal form link.

security_engineer: I'll send the abridged security questionnaire and BAA checklist within the hour. If PHI is likely, we'll flag Dedicated deployment as the recommended path.

maria_ae: Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll aim to have SDK snippets + security docs in thread before the 10am sync.
